Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Rich
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/10/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 248 as amended and reported by the Committee on Education Policy provides that educational authorities have sole authority to enter into contracts for the broadcast of sporting events. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Terri Collins, Chair
Education Policy

Committee: Education Policy

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 248 as passed the House of Representatives provides that educational authorities have sole authority to enter into contracts for the broadcast of sporting events. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Tim Melson, Chairperson
Education Policy
